page_note: Substrate-dominant page. Core teaching is the soul-binding cosmology: Sin establishes the body from the five bodies of Darkness; Living Spirit draws the soul from the five radiant Gods and binds the five faculties (mind/thought/teaching/counsel/reflection) into the five members (bone/sinew/vein/flesh/skin); five angels with exousiastai are set upon the five members of the soul. Classic Iranian five-fold correspondential mapping. Editorial fatigue manifests at the close (segs 27-31) as anti-idolatry polemic — 'doctrines of Error', 'idols of wood and gold and silver', 'serving the beasts' — extending the description of soul-bondage into a contemporary polemical attack. Page-level polemic shift 0→29.2 confirms editorial extension.
